title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 0.61 (versions follow prime numbers) is a correction of 0.59. What the living cube found never reached Luma: her night compared the recipe library with the one at the start of her caretaker instead of the one Razar found at his birth, so Razar was never born again (57 sleeps, no rebirth). Fixed and tested: he was born again and sat the cube's pieces for the first time. The result is negative: in Luma's house no recipe beats the exam without organ (13876; best, 516: 12756; the cube's most general piece, 38516: 12607). Luma did not change because of the free code: the cube judges with a newborn reader, one book at a time, and hers has already learned its books. OS unchanged (test suite: 402 passed, 0 failed). Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v0.61: corrección de la v0.59 — la noche de Luma ahora hace renacer a Razar cuando la biblioteca cambió; medido, ninguna pieza del cubo le gana todavía a su examen sin órgano. Prototipo de investigación.
